read in functions
```{r}
read_summary_counts <- function(path) {
  df <- read_tsv(path, skip = 2, show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())) %>%
    mutate(InputReads = parse_number(InputReads),
           OutputReads = parse_number(OutputReads))

  ig_productive <- df %>%
    filter(Step == "AIRR", str_detect(PathInfo, "Ig$"), OutputDescription == "Productive receptor sequences") %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    pull(OutputReads)

  tcr_productive <- df %>%
    filter(Step == "AIRR", str_detect(PathInfo, "TCR$"), OutputDescription == "Productive receptor sequences") %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    pull(OutputReads)

  tibble(consensus_pass_input = df %>%
      filter(Step == "Seqtag") %>%
      dplyr::slice(1) %>%
      pull(InputReads),
    airr_productive_total = ig_productive + tcr_productive)
}

read_filtered_airr_count <- function(ig_path, tcr_path) {
  bind_rows(read_tsv(ig_path, show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character())),
            read_tsv(tcr_path, show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))) %>%
    mutate(v_region_sequence = stringr::str_sub(toupper(sequence), start = as.integer(v_sequence_start), end = as.integer(v_sequence_end))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(c_call) & str_sub(c_call, 1, 3) == locus & !grepl("TTTTTTTTTTT", umi) & !grepl("N", junction) & !grepl("N", v_region_sequence)) %>%
    nrow()
}

read_run_counts <- function(summary_path, ig_path, tcr_path) {
  bind_cols(read_summary_counts(summary_path),
    tibble(filtered_productive_total = read_filtered_airr_count(ig_path, tcr_path)))
}
```

```{r}
  "MUSCLE5", "multi-thread",
  "~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/1_samples_longairr/1_longairr_revision/msa_runtime/sp12_top3/v8_muscle52/slurm-3lar_muscle52_1735048.out") %>%

```

```{r}
parse_slurm_runtime <- function(path) {
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)

  input_ts <- str_match(
    lines[str_detect(lines, "Input FASTA:")][1],
    "^\\[([0-9-]+ [0-9:]+)\\]"
  )[, 2]

  done_ts <- str_match(
    lines[str_detect(lines, "Done\\. Final output:")][1],
    "^\\[([0-9-]+ [0-9:]+)\\]"
  )[, 2]

  input_ts <- as.POSIXct(input_ts, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")
  done_ts <- as.POSIXct(done_ts, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", tz = "UTC")

  tibble(runtime_min = as.numeric(difftime(done_ts, input_ts, units = "mins")))
}

runtime_counts <- runtime_manifest %>%
  mutate(runtime = map(slurm_log, parse_slurm_runtime)) %>%
  unnest(runtime) %>%
  mutate(
    plot_label = case_when(
      msa_backend == "MUSCLE5" & run_setting == "threads=1" ~ "MUSCLE5 (threads=1)",
      msa_backend == "MUSCLE5" & run_setting == "multi-thread" ~ "MUSCLE5 (multi-thread)",
      TRUE ~ as.character(msa_backend)
    ),
    plot_label = fct_reorder(plot_label, runtime_min),
    runtime_text = paste0(round(runtime_min, 1), " min")
  )
```
